sources.note: Caption: 'The maximum length is 2200 in UTF-16 runes.' Accepted upload Content-Types are MP4, QuickTime and WebM, which is where mime_types comes from.

'API clients must check if the duration of the to-be-posted video follows the max_video_post_duration_sec returned in the creator_info API.' This is why max_duration_is_per_account is true: 600s is an optimistic ceiling, not a guarantee, and the real limit is only knowable per creator at dispatch time.

Third-party, NOT authoritative: source of the 600s (10 minute) third-party-upload ceiling and of the claim that standalone image posts are unavailable through this flow, which is why kinds is video-only. Replace with aggregator-enforced limits in S09.
